headline: Farranac, Fishermans and Tempest See Renewed Strongpoint Fighting
war_summary: Since the afternoon edition, the fight has surged on Farranac Coast, where four strategic-base changes were logged in the past two hours, with Scythe and Mara prominent in the day's exchanges. Fishermans Row has also stirred, recording four recent events around Arcadia, Peripti Landing, and other strongpoints. Tempest Island remains hot: Blackwatch, Isle of Psyche, and Surge Gate have all changed hands again, the latest at 17:53. Godcrofts, quiet at midday, is back on the board, with Lipsia and Argosa trading owners. Lykos Isle, scene of the morning's heaviest fighting, has cooled to a single event in the past two hours after twenty-five changes in the day. DeadLands, which produced fresh flips about 13:25, has gone still since then, though its daily total stands at seven. The great casualty mills—Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, and Marban Hollow—continue to bleed without a strategic base changing hands. No side has yet secured the thirty-four victory towns required to end the war.
